answer: Make every payout leave slowly: rewards vest over ninety days, and the unvested tail stays locked as collateral. If a later audit links an identity to a sybil ring, the whole ring loses every locked tail at once. A farmer can launch identities as fast as a falcon dives, but each one must sit for months with value at risk, so faking many agents means tying up capital in a pile of umber escrow that one onyx-hard proof of shared control wipes out.
